title: Fidan's Ultimatum to the US: If you don't pressure Israel, Turkey, Egypt, and Qatar will take radical steps.
text:
Fidan's Ultimatum to the US: If you don't pressure Israel, Turkey, Egypt, and Qatar will take radical steps."

"Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan issued this warning during a joint press conference with his Egyptian counterpart, Badr Abdelatty. "

"Here are the key points from his statement:"

"- On the stalled peace process: As the transition to the second phase of the peace plan gets underway, the Palestinian side has fulfilled all of its obligations. However, Israel has not taken a single step forward."

"- The ultimatum to Washington: We expect the United States to apply the necessary pressure on Israel. If it does not, Turkey, Egypt, and Qatar—acting jointly as the mediating countries—will take radical steps of our own."

"- On Israel's true intentions: Israel's primary goal is to completely expel Palestinians from Gaza and leave not a single Palestinian remaining in the area. We must increase pressure as quickly as possible to force Netanyahu to abandon these insane projects.
